paragraphs: The later Meremar: he said, ‘The law does not follow Rava concerning an extra [lung lobe],’ Ḥullin 47a. [The Warsaw text groups ‘Rav Aḥa’ and ‘does not’ in parentheses. In the Bavli, Meremar directs his answer to Rav Aḥa.]
